title: Generate recovery codes
purpose: Replace the backup codes for your two-factor authentication.
summary: Replace your recovery codes with a new set of ten. The old codes stop working.

tasks.title: Get a new set of recovery codes
steps: Select [[Generate]]. The new codes open on the Recovery codes page.
Save the new codes somewhere private.

good_to_know: Generating new codes invalidates every earlier code, used or not.
Generating again replaces the set again. Keep only the latest set.

items.label: Existing-code warning
items.description: When unused codes exist, explains that this generation invalidates them. There are no editable fields.

items.label: Generate
items.description: Requires sign-in, recent reauthentication and an existing non-recovery authenticator. Replaces the recovery-code record under a user lock with ten new eight-digit single-use codes, invalidating the previous set, then opens Recovery Codes.

sections.title: Navigation and limits
paragraphs: The confirmation opens in the shared form dialog over Two-factor authentication. Cancel closes it and keeps the set (opened by its address, Cancel goes to Two-factor authentication). Generation does not disable the app. Repeated successful generation replaces the set again; keep the latest set. Codes are not laboratory observations or report content.
